name: actual-budget
description: Ask your Actual Budget where the money went, and write back safely: every delete previews what it would destroy, and new transactions are checked against what is there.

settings.name: Actual server URL
settings.description: Where your Actual Budget server is reachable, for example http://localhost:5006

settings.name: Server password
settings.description: The password for your Actual server. Leave empty if your server uses OIDC and you set a session token instead.

settings.name: Budget Sync ID
settings.description: Actual shows this under Settings > Show advanced settings. It is the Sync ID, not the Budget ID shown above it: the two look alike and only the Sync ID works.

settings.name: Session token (OIDC servers only)
settings.description: For servers behind OIDC, which have no password. Use this instead of the password; if both are set, the token wins.

settings.name: Read-only mode
settings.description: Set to 1 to expose only the read and analysis tools. The write tools are not registered at all, so they never reach tool discovery.

settings.name: Toolset
settings.description: Set to chat to offer the 18 everyday tools instead of all 44: reading, recording and categorising transactions, and moving budgeted money. Setting up and repairing a budget is left out. Defaults to full.

settings.name: Other budgets this server serves
settings.description: Every budget sync id this server should serve, comma separated, when it is more than one. Each tool then takes a budget_id, each budget is opened in a process of its own, and list_budgets says which ones there are.

settings.name: Encryption passwords (several budgets)
settings.description: A JSON object of budget sync id to encryption password, for when more than one of the budgets is end-to-end encrypted: {"<sync id>": "<password>"}. With one encrypted budget the single password setting is enough.

settings.name: Budgets open at once
settings.description: How many budgets stay open at the same time, each in its own process. Defaults to 3; a fourth budget closes the one that went longest without a call.

settings.name: Minutes before an idle budget closes
settings.description: How long an open budget with nothing to do stays open. Defaults to 15.

settings.name: Seconds to wait for a budget to open
settings.description: How long a call waits for a budget that is still opening before it answers that it is still opening and nothing was sent. Defaults to 45.
